# MORROW

MORROW is a fictional product-launch concept exploring cognitive augmentation, removable neural-interface hardware, agentic tool calling, and the economics of human computational capacity.

## Product concepts
- MORROW Lattice: a fictional removable module that docks with an imagined surgically installed spinal port.
- Faculties: five fictional provisioned capabilities for research synthesis, mathematical proof, theoretical physics, experimental design, and scholarly composition.
- Brain MCP: a fictional Model Context Protocol gateway concept exposing narrowly scoped Faculty tools to enterprise and local AI agents.
- PULSE: a fictional usage token earned by offering spare edge capacity and spent when a Faculty is invoked.
- Cognitive Lease: a fictional arrangement in which the Faculties remain active while the Lattice is physically connected.

## Important disclosure
All device, surgery, neural-computation, token, exchange and MCP service details are speculative fiction. MORROW is not a real medical device, neural implant, cognitive enhancement technology, token, or functioning MCP server. No real surgery, neural data processing, or computation marketplace is offered.
